name: Metric card
summary: KPI tile for dashboards: label, value and the change since the last period. Optional icon, menu and a link at the bottom.
use: Key numbers at the top of a dashboard or overview, usually 2 to 4 side by side.
avoid: A trend over time: use a chart (coming later).
anatomy: Trend: arrow and change, with context ("vs last month").
reactProps: Required. Pass the value already formatted.
Choose by meaning, not by direction. Rising costs are "down" (red) if that is bad.
Words for screen readers. Default Up, Down, No change.
behaviour: Put tiles in a grid with the class rb-metric-grid (auto-fill, at least 240 px).
a11y: Group with the label as its name (role="group").
The trend is not only color: arrow, sign and hidden text ("Up: +12.4%").
Numbers use tabular-nums, so they line up.
content: Keep the label short, without the unit if the value already has it.
Meta says what you compare with.
do: Use the same period in all tiles.
dont: More than 4 tiles in a row.
open: Small chart (sparkline) in the tile: waits for the choice of a chart solution.
